title: Why AI Forgets the Start of Long Chats (Context Windows in 45s)
audience: Heavy ChatGPT/Claude users, AI-automation builders, junior devs
whyCare: Everyone has seen a long chat 'forget' instructions; the context window explains it and how to work around it.

evidence.claim: Matt Pocock 'Most devs don't understand how context windows work' 298,011 views (~11 months); 'Context Management in Claude Code' 433,327 views (~5 months)

competitors.title: Most devs don't understand how context windows work (Matt Pocock)
Why AI Forgets Your Name (Context Window Explained) (Short)

angle: Conveyor-belt diagram: messages enter a fixed-size window box; when full, the oldest block slides out. Bars chart: window sizes in 'pages of text' (published model limits only, cited with dates). Fix card: summarise / restate key instructions.
hook: You told the AI your rules 50 messages ago. It no longer sees them.
strengths: Relatable pain point; very weak Shorts competition; simple visual metaphor
weaknesses: Model limits change often; 'forgets' oversimplifies tools that compact or summarise
